title: bridge-onramp-tactical-sync-2028-02-07
body:
Bridge / Onramp tactical sync - 2028-02-07
Facilitator: Maya Chen (SE) 
Scribe: Diego Rivera 
Time: 09:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Maya C., Diego R., Hannah S., Liam O., Priya R., Ryan (Customer Success), Anya (SRE on-call)

Agenda (quick): 1) Blocker triage (top 3) 2) Customer update snapshots (3 prioritised) 3) Handover readiness check 4) Action assignments / dates

Quick wins since last sync:
- Acadia: completed certificate rotation for staging endpoints; staging smoke tests now pass (thanks Hannah + infra).
- Integration script PR (#199) merged to main; automated post-onboard checks running in CI.
- Telemetry dashboards (per-route latency) added to onramp Confluence page by Liam.

Top blockers (priority order)
1) Private deployment certificate chain mismatch (Veridian) - impact: cannot complete canary traffic routing to private control plane.
   - Symptoms: customer reports TLS handshake failures when our routing proxy attempts mTLS.
   - Current hypothesis: customer rotated intermediate CA; our deployed sidecar image still bundles old root.
   - Actions: Priya to validate cert chain with Veridian (JIRA-4621). SRE Anya to coordinate sidecar image rebuild with new CACerts. Target: 2028-02-09 EOD.

2) KV cache warmup variability (Tidewater) - impact: high first-request latency for batched chat sessions.
   - Details: initial prefix cache misses for multi-turn sessions causing 300-500ms extra tail latency spikes under small bursts.
   - Hypothesis: batch slot reuse + cache eviction policy interacting with short-lived sessions.
   - Actions: Diego to run controlled repro with synthetic traffic, capture KV cache hit rates and slot reuse patterns (JIRA-4688). Dev suggestion: add deterministic KV prewarm step in onboarding harness. Target: 2028-02-10 mid-day.

3) Endpoint throttling / quota misconfig for Dedicated pools (internal) - impact: sporadic 429s during customer smoke tests.
   - Root cause: autoscaler recently changed max-concurrency knob; policy mismatch with route-level quotas.
   - Actions: Maya to patch quota defaults on staging and create canary route to validate. Ops to roll a config change to dedicated-staging by 2028-02-08 morning.

Customer snapshots (status, risks, next steps)
- Acadia Health (onboarding, private deployment)
  - Stage: Final validation, moving toward production week-of 2028-02-13.
  - Recent: cert rotation resolved for staging. Performance tests: P50 45ms token, P95 120ms token; meets target.
  - Outstanding: SOC review pending — Acadia asked for additional KMS audit logs (consequence for Private). Action: Ryan to deliver audit artifact template by 2028-02-09.
  - Handover: SE -> CS playbook drafted; request one more security Q&A session scheduled 2028-02-10.

- Veridian Financial (private control-plane)
  - Stage: Blocked on TLS handshake (see Blocker #1).
  - Recent: On-call infra verified our proxy certs; customer shows rotated intermediate CA after their devops change.
  - Risk: If TLS not cleared this week, scheduled canary for 2028-02-12 will slip by 1 sprint.
  - Contingency: Offer an alternate routing path via hosted-proxy with IP allowlist to complete canary (customer agreement required). Action: Priya to propose to customer and get approval 2028-02-08.

- Tidewater Logistics (Hosted -> Dedicated migration)
  - Stage: Migration dry-run in progress.
  - Recent: Dry-run revealed KV warmup variability and one embedding indexing job failure (timeout).
  - Risk: Additional 429s when scaling from 2->8 replicas in a short window.
  - Actions: Diego + Liam to run scale-up repro and tune autoscaler and batching thresholds; target 2028-02-11. Embedding job: Hannah to investigate timeouts (likely network I/O or disk pressure).

Handover readiness (checklist items)
- Docs: SE playbook checklist complete (initial draft) — missing: runbook for rollback during canary (owner: Maya). Due 2028-02-09.
- Automations: post-onboard smoke tests now in CI but need flakiness reduction; flakey tests flagged in PR #199. Owner: Liam.
- Security/compliance: KMS audit artifacts pending for Acadia — Ryan assigned.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool buffer for Tidewater confirmed for week-of-migration but require permanent scaling policy update. Owner: Ops (Cheng).

Open actions (owner — due)
- Priya: Confirm Veridian CA chain and propose hosted-proxy fallback (2028-02-08).
- Anya (SRE): Build sidecar image with updated CACerts and push to staging registry (2028-02-09).
- Diego: KV warmup repro, collect traces and cache metrics (2028-02-10).
- Hannah: Investigate embedding indexing timeout and propose mitigation (2028-02-11).
- Liam: Flakiness triage for onboarding CI checks + finalize telemetry dashboard links on Confluence (2028-02-09).
- Maya: Rollback runbook draft for canary + update SE playbook (2028-02-09).
- Ryan (CS): Deliver KMS audit artifact template to Acadia (2028-02-09).

Decisions made
- Agree to use hosted-proxy fallback for Veridian if customer cannot reconcile CA before 2028-02-10; use IP allowlist + limited traffic during canary.
- Temporarily relax dedicated-route concurrency knob to previous baseline while we tune autoscaler; Ops to document change.

Risks / escalations
- Risk: Multiple customers hitting TLS/cert churn at same time increases SRE burden; propose a short-term runbook for cert rotation coordination (owner: Priya).
- Escalation: If Veridian requires HSM-backed certs and timeline slips >1 week, escalate to Sales and Legal for contract amendment.

Parking lot / longer-term improvements
- Improve onboarding harness to include deterministic KV prewarm step and synthetic multi-turn sequences.
- Add a pre-migration checklist item to validate customer CA rotations and KMS policies 5 days before canary.
- Consider adding a small warm pool of dedicated instances for the first 30 minutes post-migration to absorb cache cold starts.

Notes / references
- Replay link for today: slack thread #onramp-bridge (see pinned messages).
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-ONRAMP-42 for playbook.
- CI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/integration-scripts/pull/199
- JIRA: JIRA-4621 (Veridian TLS), JIRA-4688 (KV cache investigation)

Next sync: 2028-02-09 09:00 PT (short pulse if blockers resolved)

Scribe notes end.
